<notes>
kept -> base harness -> inv1 candidate has no harness changes (harness.diff shows "no change"), but its rollout produced "unknown" (incomplete reasoning, task gave up mid-computation). Base rollout on identical harness produced "23" with complete reasoning. dom1 candidate also has no harness changes (identical harness.diff), and its rollout produced "23", matching base1. Since both candidates propose zero changes to the harness and base rollout succeeded on the same code, keeping base is the only evidence-driven choice. Neither inv1.md nor dom1.md decision documents identify a trajectory moment that would justify any edit.
</notes>

KEEP_BASE
